method: OpenAI imagegen; newly drawn poses using project-created fan art

Movement must redraw jaws, limbs, knees and torso anatomically, NOT warp the entire body. Preserve all horns, armor and limb counts. Do not mirror reference designs. Ranged and melee poses details: Palmon green plant with pink head flower. Windup pulls leafy arms back, knees bend, head flower tilts. Ranged release fingers extend as short unambiguous vine fingers toward RIGHT (not across cell), rooted legs stable. Melee leaf-arm swipe. Hit head flower and arms fold left. No extra vines outside silhouette.
